INSERT INTO credit_note_number_counters (organization_id, year, last_number)
                    VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
                    ON CONFLICT (organization_id, year)
                    DO UPDATE SET
                        last_number = GREATEST(
                            credit_note_number_counters.last_number, EXCLUDED.last_number
                        ),
                        updated_at = now()
